mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y INDPRO growth drops by >2pp but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, as measured by the year-over-year change in the housing starts index, signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y HOUST growth drops by >10pp but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate, as measured by the month-over-month change in the effective federal funds rate, signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: M/M FEDFUNDS change > 0.25% but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An inverted yield curve, as measured by the spread between the 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, signals a coming recession that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 10y-2y yield spread inverts but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, as measured by the month-over-month change in the unemployment rate, signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: M/M UNRATE change > 0.3pp but SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the consumer price index, as measured by the year-over-year change in the CPI, signals rising inflation that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: Y/Y CPIAUCSL inflation > 3% but SPX 60-day returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.
